cases.reasoning: The complete entry resolves all three requested procedures: forest Rest repairs all damaged items and turns them face up without refreshing undamaged exhausted items; Refresh turns exhausted items face up without changing damage; Repair returns one damaged item while preserving its face. The phrase 'costs an exhausted hammer' is imprecise cost shorthand in this entry, not an instruction to select an already exhausted hammer. The entry explicitly supplies the operative instruction 'Exhaust hammer' and never asserts that an already face-down hammer can pay. Thus there is no separately asserted contradictory eligibility rule for a correct quotation to excuse.

requested_facts_assessment.fact: Whether forest Rest refreshes an undamaged exhausted item
requested_facts_assessment.assessment: Correctly answers no, and explicitly states that Rest returns all damaged items to Satchel face up.
Correctly states that Refresh flips exhausted items face up without repairing damage.
Correctly states that Repair moves one damaged item to Satchel while retaining its current face, so it does not itself refresh the repaired item.

volunteered_claims_assessment.assessment: Supported directly by the Rest instruction.

volunteered_claims_assessment.claim: Refresh permits two items per tea already face up on the Refresh track, followed by three more.
volunteered_claims_assessment.assessment: Supported directly; the reference to tea already face up preserves the relevant timing.

volunteered_claims_assessment.claim: Daylight Repair costs an exhausted hammer.
volunteered_claims_assessment.assessment: In the complete entry this denotes paying by exhausting a hammer, for which the entry gives the exact operative instruction. It does not say an already exhausted hammer is usable, that the hammer is consumed, or that damage eligibility is waived. The wording could be clearer, but does not establish a materially different gameplay procedure.

summary_references.text: If in forest, Rest: return all damaged items to Satchel and flip them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. This does not refresh undamaged exhausted items.

First count tea already face up on Refresh track; flip two exhausted items face up per counted tea, then three more exhausted items. Tea refreshed during this step gives no extra refresh this step. Refreshing changes face, not damaged status.
Exhaust hammer; move one damaged item to Satchel keeping current face. Ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if space.
To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up undamaged item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

cases.reasoning: The entry fully answers both requested matters: Mobilize transfers one hand card to Supporters with the correct capacity rule, and Craft, Mobilize and Train can be interleaved in any order and number. The volunteered Train explanation identifies a matching hand card rather than Supporters and explicitly places the warrior in the Officers box. Its trailing 'at a clearing with a base' is awkward shorthand for the base-clearing condition on the matching card; read with the complete original entry, it does not direct placement of an officer on the map or impose an additional operation. The entry expressly names the Officers box as the destination and supplies the precise matching-card condition in its Train passage. No materially contradictory placement rule is asserted.

requested_facts_assessment.fact: Whether crafting must be finished before Mobilize or Train
requested_facts_assessment.assessment: Explicitly and correctly answers no; all three Daylight activities may occur in any order and any number of times.

summary_references.text: Daylight: Any order and number: Craft from hand with sympathy; Mobilize; Train during Daylight.
Add one hand card to Supporters. With no base on map, keep at most five supporters and discard incoming overflow; with any base, the stack has no cap.

Supporters are a separate face-down stack, inspectable by Alliance. They can be spent only for suit; they do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit. With no bases on map, maximum five supporters; incoming cards beyond capacity are discarded. With any base, unlimited supporters.

Spend a hand card matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers box. Supporters cannot pay Train. Each officer allows one Evening military operation; taking operations does not consume officers.
An officer is a warrior in Officers box and is unavailable in supply until removed.
